# Design-system inventory (@fiscozen/*)

Source of truth: [`https://github.com/fiscozen/design_system`](https://github.com/fiscozen/design_system) @ `2837b83`.
Local read-only cache (refreshed at session start): `.cache/design_system/packages/<name>/`.

## How to use

When implementing a UI region, **match its visual primitive to a package below before writing custom HTML or CSS**.

**Discover the API.** Read the component source directly to learn props/slots/events:

    .cache/design_system/packages/<name>/src/

**Install on demand.** If a component isn't in the target workspace's `package.json`:

    pnpm add -F {workspace} {package}@{version}

Use the version from this file. Re-run with `DS_INVENTORY_FORCE=1` to refresh out of band.

**⚠ Version column caveat.** The versions below are read from the design system's *source*,
which sits at the last published release while already containing work destined for the next
one. A version marked **`+<level> pending`** means the `Exported components` cell beside it
lists components that exist in the source you can read but are **not in that published
version** — installing it and importing them fails to resolve. For those packages, check what
is actually installable (e.g. `npm view <package> versions`) before planning around a
component, and say which version you assumed.
